messages:
olivia: heads up — after the 1.29 control plane upgrade i'm seeing cluster-autoscaler filter out our gpu nodegroups. scale-up requests fail, and scale-down is leaving old nodes around.

deploy-bot: k8s controlplane upgrade to v1.29.0 completed for cluster 'eu-gpu-1' at 2026-03-18T02:01:11Z :white_check_mark:

kai: logs?

olivia: pasted CA log snippet:
```
I0318 02:03:22.123456 1 static_autoscaler.go:500] NodeGroup eu-gpu-1-gpupool filtered: node taints mismatch: expected 'gpu=true' got 'node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true'
I0318 02:03:22.123789 1 scale_up.go:300] No scaling candidates
```

olivia: looks like taint key got normalized in the new node webhook for managed nodegroups. previously our node taint key was `gpu=true:NoSchedule`, now it's `node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true:NoSchedule` so CA's filter doesn't match the configured nodegroup taint set.

samir: ah yeah — autoscaler we run compares exact taint keys from the NodeGroup CRD vs node objects. if keys change, NG gets treated as incompatible and skipped during resource matching.

jess: quick mitigation: for now add an alias taint to nodes so they have both keys until CA fix is rolled.

kai: how to add alias quickly? we need a low blast change.

jess: run on affected nodes:
```
kubectl get nodes -l nodegroup=eu-gpu-1-gpupool -o name | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl taint nodes {} gpu=true:NoSchedule --overwrite
```
that will reintroduce the old key on existing nodes. new nodes from the MNG will still have the new prefixed key though.

samir: i'm opening a hotfix PR to normalize taint keys in autoscaler matching logic (strip node.kubernetes.io/ prefix when comparing). PR: https://github.com/redwood/cluster-autoscaler/pull/452 (canary patch)

olivia: cost note — idle GPU hours spiked after the upgrade, knocking ~3.4k USD for eu-gpu this morning. we need patch asap.

infra-bot: alert: gpu-idle-costs/eu-gpu-1 > $3k threshold triggered at 2026-03-18T03:10Z

samir: i'll roll the canary to staging now, then to two dedicated pools if green. patch rollout plan: canary -> 1 pool -> remaining pools. estimate 90m to prod.

jess: i'll do the canary deploy and monitor CA logs + scale activity. if any rollback needed i'll flag in #incidents.

kai: thanks team — please ping once pr is merged and when nodes are normalized. :thumbsup:

olivia: tagging customer-impacted list and working with solutions to contact a couple of folks who saw latency. @samir @jess
